headline: Request verification required
body: Please wait while access is being verified.
noscript_required: JavaScript must be enabled in your browser to complete verification!
dummy_notice: Dummy mode is active. Set verification_mode to cap, altcha, or hcaptcha to require a real verification.
error_unavailable: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many verification attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_insecure_transport: Verification is only available over HTTPS on non-local hosts.
error_widget_load: The verification component could not be loaded.
error_widget_runtime: The verification component returned an error.
status_reload_ready: Reload the page to try again.
